_comment: Synthetic historical tickets (no real personal data). 'resolution.level' sets the knowledge trust level; tickets sharing a 'group' are near-duplicates of each other.

tickets.title: VPN authentication / MFA failure (Cisco Anyconnect)
tickets.description: My VPN isn't connecting this morning. AnyConnect keeps timing out on login right after I enter the 2FA code. Windows 11 laptop, working from home.

resolution.summary: Stale AnyConnect authentication session. Quit the VPN client, refresh the SSO session in the browser, restart the VPN client service and flush DNS, then reconnect and approve MFA within 60 seconds.
resolution.root_cause: Stale authentication token cached by the VPN client after an SSO session expiry.
steps: Quit the VPN client completely from the system tray
Sign out of the company SSO portal in your browser and sign back in
Check that your device clock is set automatically
Restart the VPN client and connect to the default gateway
Approve the MFA prompt within 60 seconds

tickets.title: VPN times out after MFA prompt
tickets.description: Cannot get onto the VPN, it asks for my authenticator code and then just times out. Tried twice. MacBook.

tickets.title: VPN keeps disconnecting
tickets.description: The VPN connects fine but drops every 10 minutes, I have to reconnect all the time. Home Wi-Fi.

resolution.summary: Unstable home Wi-Fi combined with a stale DNS cache. Use a wired connection or move closer to the router, close other VPN tools, restart the VPN client service and flush DNS.
resolution.root_cause: Wi-Fi packet loss causing tunnel renegotiation.
steps: Switch to a wired connection or move closer to the router
Close any other VPN or proxy tools
Restart the VPN client service
Flush the DNS cache
Reconnect and keep the client open for five minutes

tickets.title: VPN connection drops frequently
tickets.description: Remote access VPN connects then disconnects after a few minutes, several times per hour.

tickets.title: Outlook crashing (Outlook)
tickets.description: Outlook crashes every time I open it since yesterday's update. Windows 10 desktop.

resolution.summary: A faulty third-party COM add-in crashed Outlook after the update. Start Outlook in safe mode, disable recently installed add-ins, clear the Outlook cache and restart.
steps: Close Outlook and make sure no Outlook process is running
Hold Ctrl and open Outlook to start in safe mode
Go to File > Options > Add-ins and disable recently installed COM add-ins
Restart Outlook normally

tickets.title: Outlook closes immediately on start
tickets.description: Outlook freezes and then closes as soon as it loads my inbox.

tickets.title: Cannot send or receive email
tickets.description: Emails are stuck in my outbox and I am not receiving new mail in Outlook, web mail seems fine.

resolution.summary: Outlook was in Work Offline mode and a 40 MB message was blocking the Outbox. Turn off Work Offline and move the large message to Drafts.
resolution.root_cause: Work Offline toggled on plus oversized attachment.
steps: On the Send/Receive tab, make sure Work Offline is turned off
Open the Outbox and move any large message to Drafts
Remove attachments over 25 MB or share them as links
Click Send/Receive All Folders

tickets.title: Account locked out
tickets.description: My account is locked, I can't sign in to my laptop after changing my password.

resolution.summary: An old password saved on the phone's mail app kept failing and locked the account. Unlock the account, then update the password on the phone.
resolution.root_cause: Stale credentials on a mobile device.
steps: Unlock the account (the helpdesk agent can do this with your approval)
Update the password in your phone's mail app or remove and re-add the account
Forget and rejoin saved Wi-Fi networks that use your company login

tickets.title: Password reset request
tickets.description: I forgot my password and cannot log in to my computer.

resolution.summary: Use the self-service password portal to reset the password with MFA, then sign in again on every device.
steps: Open the self-service password portal from the sign-in page link 'Forgot password'
Verify with your registered MFA method
Choose a new password of at least 12 characters
Sign out and in again on laptop, phone mail and VPN client

tickets.title: Forgot my password
tickets.description: Need to reset my password, I can't remember it after the holidays.

tickets.title: Printer not printing
tickets.description: Documents sent to the 3rd floor printer just sit in the queue and never print.

resolution.summary: Print spooler on the laptop was stuck. Cancel all queued jobs, restart the print spooler and print a test page.
steps: Open Settings > Printers & scanners > your printer > Open print queue
Cancel all documents
Restart the print spooler
Print a test page

tickets.title: Print jobs stuck in queue
tickets.description: Nothing prints, jobs are stuck in the print queue on floor 3.

tickets.title: Printer paper jam
tickets.description: The printer near reception shows a paper jam error and blinking orange light.

resolution.summary: Paper jammed in tray 2 feed path. Open trays and front panel, remove paper along the paper path, close panels firmly.
steps: Open the trays and front panel as shown on the display
Remove jammed paper in the direction of the paper path
Close all panels firmly
Report any service code shown on the display

tickets.title: Wi-Fi connectivity issue
tickets.description: Connected to CORP-WIFI but no internet on my laptop, phone works fine.

resolution.summary: Corrupted Wi-Fi profile. Forget CORP-WIFI, reconnect with company credentials and flush DNS.
steps: Turn Wi-Fi off and on
Forget the CORP-WIFI network
Reconnect with your company credentials
Flush the DNS cache
Restart the laptop if it still has no internet

tickets.title: Slow network
tickets.description: Internet has been really slow in the afternoon, video calls lag.

resolution.summary: Access point on floor 2 was overloaded; IT added capacity. Users should prefer wired connections for calls.
steps: Run the intranet speed test and attach the result
Use a wired connection for video calls
Pause large downloads and cloud sync during calls

tickets.title: Software installation request (Figma)
tickets.description: I need Figma installed on my laptop for the new design project.

resolution.summary: Figma is available in Company Software Center; install it from there without admin rights.
steps: Open Company Software Center from the Start menu
Search for Figma
Click Install
Sign in with your company account

tickets.title: Software license / activation issue
tickets.description: Adobe Acrobat says my license has expired and won't let me edit PDFs.

resolution.summary: Sign out and back in to refresh the license; if no seat is assigned request one in the self-service portal.
steps: Open the application's Account menu and sign out
Sign in again with your company account
Make sure you are online or on VPN
If it says no license is assigned, request a seat in the self-service portal

tickets.title: Application crash / error (Excel)
tickets.description: Excel freezes and crashes when I open large spreadsheets.

resolution.summary: Update Office, clear the Excel cache and restart the computer.
steps: Save your work and close Excel
Check for updates in Software Center
Clear the application cache
Restart your computer

tickets.title: Peripheral device issue
tickets.description: My docking station stopped working, external monitors and keyboard not detected.

resolution.summary: Power-cycle the docking station and update its firmware from Software Center.
steps: Unplug the dock from power and the laptop
Wait 30 seconds and reconnect
Install the dock firmware update from Software Center
Test the monitor directly on the laptop if still not working

tickets.title: Battery / charging issue
tickets.description: Laptop battery won't charge past 40 percent and dies quickly.

resolution.summary: Battery reached end of life; hardware support replaced the battery.
steps: Try the original charger in a wall socket
Hold the power button for 20 seconds to reset the power controller
Request a battery replacement if capacity stays low

tickets.title: Suspicious email / phishing report
tickets.description: Got a suspicious email pretending to be from payroll asking me to confirm my bank details. I did not click anything.

resolution.summary: Report the message with the Report phishing button and do not interact with it.
steps: Do not click links, open attachments or reply
Use the Report phishing button in Outlook
Warn the impersonated colleague through another channel

tickets.title: Suspected malware infection
tickets.description: Lots of pop-ups keep appearing and my browser homepage changed by itself.

resolution.summary: Adware browser extension removed by the Security team; device scanned clean.
resolution.root_cause: Malicious browser extension installed from a download site.

tickets.title: Server / service outage
tickets.description: The HR portal is down for everyone, returns HTTP 503 errors. Production system.

resolution.summary: Application pool crashed after a memory leak; Server Operations recycled the pool and deployed the fix.
resolution.root_cause: Memory leak in the portal release 4.2.

tickets.title: Database access problem
tickets.description: Getting login failed for user when connecting to the sales reporting database from Power BI.

resolution.summary: Access to the reporting database requires an approved access request; after approval update saved credentials in the reporting tool.
steps: Confirm you are on the office network or VPN
Request access in the access request portal with manager approval
After approval, update the saved credentials in the reporting tool

tickets.title: Database performance degradation
tickets.description: Month-end finance report queries on the production database are timing out for our whole team.
